name: Iced Americano
design: Light Latte surfaces with blue-black typography, bright blue accents, and a stronger secondary text hierarchy. This palette has not undergone structured evaluation with color-vision-deficient users.

primary.cue: Recommended: explicit information label; link affordances must be provided by the application

error.cue: Recommended: explicit error label and bold text, provided by the application

warning.cue: Recommended: warning icon and explicit label, provided by the application

success.cue: Recommended: check icon and explicit success label, provided by the application

blue.reason: Bright blue accent with WCAG AA normal-text contrast on Base; other backgrounds require separate review

mauve.reason: Dark purple with greater simulated distance from blue and higher text contrast; green and red pairings require usage-specific review

green.reason: Blue-teal success accent intended for use with explicit non-color cues
